title: Big Data and Marketing Analytics in Gaming: Combining Empirical Models and Field Experimentation
authors: Harikesh S. Nair; Sanjog Misra; William J. Hornbuckle; Ranjan Mishra; Anand Acharya
eligible_reason: Firm analytics framework: dynamic choice models with targeting endogeneity correction, validated by a field experiment. Package holds only a Monte Carlo of the bin-based estimator (appendix). No DiD.
design_notes: Code for sims/MGMSimulations.R simulates data and runs lm(y ~ x2 + z) within bins; no empirical code.
data_files_note: No data; only appendix simulation code (MGM transaction data proprietary).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl read. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
